author: PC Gamer
text:
Ubisoft's NFT tactics game, a thing that still exists, is shutting down in October
Technically, it shed its Web3 functionality in May, but it didn't seem to help much.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After a year and a half of rigorous testing, Path of Exile 2 devs finally convinced Nvidia to fix a driver bug by sending it an entire PC
We're finally free.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Get more than 100 games for just $10 in a new bundle supporting laid-off game devs
The Game Industry Hardship Fund bundle is live now on Itch.io.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Bulletstorm is the stupidest game ever made, and also one of the cleverest shooters ever
Enjoying the high-kicks and low-brows of a timeless FPS.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Anthropic sees OpenAI cybersecurity disaster and says 'hold my beer,' reveals it accidentally hacked 3 companies in as many months without noticing
I'm sure this is fine.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Sony exec says killing discs won't make the PlayStation 6 too much like a PC: 'Going forward, we can coexist peacefully with PC games'
Despite pushback, Sony isn't changing its mind about dropping physical discs in 2028.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Former WoW designer says Blizzard had no way to measure maximum player DPS while building early raids—so the studio enlisted its strongest sickos to grind target dummies
When in doubt, do your own DPS and round up.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Silent Hill producer believes shaking up the series was necessary to win over players because 'at best, only about half of the original users will return with a remake'
Silent Hill f changed the game, literally.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I am obsessed with The Weeknd's slow descent into Persona-addled madness, including Photoshopping a tattoo of Persona 5's biggest baddie on his arm
Hell, The Weeknd might be a bigger nerd than I am.

author: PC Gamer
text:
It seems like AMD's Zen 6 LP CPU cores will be a mixture of architectures going all the way back to Zen 2
I'd love to see these thrown into a gaming laptop.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I made a hyper organised plant shop in Leafy Corner because the people want order not whimsy
I wonder if this'll translate into keeping my own plants alive.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Facepunch director Alistair McFarlane, who once offered to buy New World from Amazon and faked us out about Rust 2, has left the company
McFarlane says he's lived his dream, but it's time to start tending to other parts of his life.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Nexus Mods finally tightens the screws on AI, though it's still playing softball with the tide of slop
"Failure to correctly tag mods, including undisclosed generative AI usage, may be subject to moderation action."

author: PC Gamer
text:
First AMD RX 9050 8 GB review suggests RTX 3060-like performance but with some strange spec discrepancies
We'll have to test one for ourselves to make up our minds.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Filming has wrapped on Garland's Elden Ring movie just 6 months after it started, according to a now deleted instagram post
The speedrunners would be so proud.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Total War: Warhammer 40k's siege reset is one of the things I'm looking forward to most
You can't have gate bugs if there are no gates.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Google Earth let me turn my hometown into a warzone with AI prompts, and the disinformation possibilities are disturbing
Google says it takes this seriously, but that sounds as fake as the images I've generated with the tool.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Report shows 34% of physical PS5 games and 50% of Xbox Series X games do not work fully without a download first
Are consoles following PC's lead?

author: PC Gamer
text:
All Genshin Impact 7.0 livestream codes
Grab the Primogems from the Snezhnaya special program.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Remakes are the backbone to Capcom's success as they provide 'financial resources' for new Resident Evil games or standalone ideas like Pragmata
"The team is giving everything it has right now."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Star Wars will also be coming to D&D, and I'm worried Hasbro's trying to turn a TTRPG into Magic: The Gathering again
Secret draconic lair.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Mchose K7 V2 Ultra+ review
Great specs with a Viper V3/V4 Pro's shape, for less.

author: PC Gamer
text:
AMD is reportedly raising graphics card prices—it was just waiting for Nvidia to do it first
It's not a good time to buy a PC.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The voice of Lady D and Orin the Red will be back for the next D&D videogame
Maggie Robertson joins the cast of Warlock.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dark Sun, D&D's most heavy metal setting, will be back in 2027
Finally, a survival game where I don't have to punch trees.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The mod we called 'the best Fallout game you'll play this year' back in 2018 just launched on GOG
If you missed it back then, it's easier than ever to play it now.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The rumors were true, Dungeons & Dragons' first 'Universes Beyond' crossover will be with World of Warcraft
Finally, I can catch the Corrupted Blood plague in person.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Saudi Arabia's $55 billion takeover of Electronic Arts will happen next week
EA says all regulatory hurdles are cleared, so all that's left to do is to do it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Xbox revenues dipped $1.7 billion last year, but Asha Sharma predicts a 'return to growth' by mid-2027
The numbers are big and impressive, but the main message appears to be that Xbox isn't going anywhere.

author: PC Gamer
text:
There's a timeline where Dark Souls was a PlayStation exclusive, but Sony lost out on the chance because it wouldn't publish Demon's Souls in North America
Things could always be worse.
